items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: His wife happened to be Helen Grayco, who was the vocalist and singer with Spike Jones for years.

ctx.x: What prompted you to move to the West Coast? JV; Well after I moved down to Miami in ’65 I was there for — I got married and had a couple of kids in the 70s. My daughter was born in ’72 and a son in ’77. And in ’79 the

bottom fell out of the business. I did have a hotel job. That’s another thing. I did work in a hotel in Miami. That was pretty steady and that was very good for me. Financially it set me up pretty good. But the bottom fell out of the business in Miami too. Condominiums became the big word, the big thing, people became residents instead of tourists. And it just shot the music business. The hotel business was shot and so hence the music business too. So it was time to leave. There’s always a time when you have to…
They like that kind of stuff.
